metadata.coordinateReference: WGS84 / EPSG:4326. space is the unmodified source [longitude, latitude] pair. Plate carree angular plot: degrees, not ground distances.
metadata.coordinatePrecision: Mapped station or rail-stop points representing each station complex. Original precision is preserved, without averaging or schematic displacement; not independently survey-certified or separate platform positions.
metadata.note: Offline service snapshot, not real-time operations. All operator-listed passenger stops are checked against the line roster. Branch trunks are deduplicated per line; Line 4 closes its ring. Shared 3/4 segments keep both line colors and filter separately. Segments connect passenger stops, not surveyed track geometry. Same-named separated sites retain distinct coordinates. Fare gates, transfer walks and durations are not modeled.
